real_route_measurement_streams.description: Continuous environmental tracks consisting of thousands of sequential observation rows mapped across target cities.

route_metadata_columns.project_id: Identifier for the master field study (e.g., picopatt_montpellier).
route_metadata_columns.track_id: Identifier for the selected route segment profile (e.g., ecusson, antigone).
route_metadata_columns.point_id: Continuous, sequential point identifier indicating spatial order along the track.
route_metadata_columns.section_duration: Time duration of the section (populated exclusively at section boundary points).
route_metadata_columns.section_speed: Planned or recorded average pacing speed within the section.
route_metadata_columns.section_warning: Flag indicating sensor issues or route anomalies.
route_metadata_columns.gnss_accuracy: GPS/GNSS localization horizontal accuracy threshold value.
route_metadata_columns.lon_ontrack: Projected longitude position matched directly to the urban tracking route.
route_metadata_columns.lat_ontrack: Projected latitude position matched directly to the urban tracking route.
route_metadata_columns.lon_rtk: Raw RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) corrected longitude coordinate stream.
route_metadata_columns.lat_rtk: Raw RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) corrected latitude coordinate stream.
route_metadata_columns.sun_azimuth: Calculated geometric solar azimuth angle for radiation adjustments.
route_metadata_columns.sun_height: Calculated geometric solar elevation angle relative to the horizon.

environmental_variable_columns.tair_thermohygro: Ambient air temperature recorded via standard thermohygrometer probe (°C).
environmental_variable_columns.tair_tc1: Fast-response air temperature recorded via fine-wire thermocouple Channel 1 (°C).
environmental_variable_columns.tair_tc2: Fast-response air temperature recorded via fine-wire thermocouple Channel 2 (°C).
environmental_variable_columns.tair_anemo: Ambient air temperature recorded directly at the ultrasonic anemometer sensor (°C).
environmental_variable_columns.rh_thermohygro: Relative humidity percentage recorded via standard probe (%).
environmental_variable_columns.wdir: Calculated localized wind direction angle degrees (0-360°).
environmental_variable_columns.sw_up: Incoming vertical shortwave solar radiation flux ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.sw_front: Directional shortwave solar radiation arriving from the front hemisphere ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.sw_back: Directional shortwave solar radiation arriving from the rear hemisphere ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.sw_left: Directional shortwave solar radiation arriving from the left hemisphere ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.sw_right: Directional shortwave solar radiation arriving from the right hemisphere ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_up: Downwelling longwave thermal atmospheric radiation flux ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_down: Upwelling longwave thermal radiation emitted from the ground plane ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_front: Directional longwave thermal radiation tracking front hemisphere fields ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_back: Directional longwave thermal radiation tracking rear hemisphere fields ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_left: Directional longwave thermal radiation tracking left hemisphere fields ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.lw_right: Directional longwave thermal radiation tracking right hemisphere fields ($W/m^2$).
environmental_variable_columns.tmrt: Mean Radiant Temperature calculated across the six directional radiation axes (°C).
environmental_variable_columns.pet: Physiological Equivalent Temperature index measuring composite thermal comfort (°C).
